name: source-structure
outcome: Make generated schemas, manifests, explicit gaps and deterministic validators trustworthy.

name: source-authority
outcome: Decide which upstream schema and records may supply candidate contract inputs.

name: shared-symbol-ownership
outcome: Resolve repeated public symbols into shared imports, qualified homonyms or rejected duplicates.

name: family-axis-evidence
outcome: Produce bounded evidence once per family-axis instead of once per library.

name: applicability-ratification
outcome: Ratify clustered axis applicability and isolate only true library-local exceptions.

name: exact-contract-specification
outcome: Lower shared modules plus local residual decisions into exact public contracts.

name: implementation
outcome: Implement exact contracts without inventing unresolved semantic defaults.

name: qualification-and-product-acceptance
outcome: Require executable laws, independent differentials and product-specific acceptance.
